recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore source/rxnorm.html or duplicate the RxNorm display SQL in FHIR core; future wording changes for RxNorm guidance should be made in HL7 Terminology/THO unless core's outgoing link or delegation text becomes stale.
issue_request: FHIR-19520 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core-CodeSystem after STU3. It asked to clarify the correct RxNorm CUI display by adding a separate display section, verifying the RxNorm SQL guidance, and moving or copying that guidance from the RxNorm MySQL Database section.
initial_application: The request was applied in source/rxnorm.html by f068a8c3f730b481083ddb7ff6ebd5a145a5c7fc, which added a Correct RxNorm Display section and linked the Display summary to it, and by 97be17fdeb2746d8842fe53b531cf360649bbbba, which changed the example SQL to use TTY in ('SCD', 'SBD') and made the query language more tentative.
additional_context: FHIR-18661 was the earlier no-change ballot comment that spawned this non-ballot task, and FHIR-19524 was closed as a duplicate of FHIR-19520. Later FHIR-33127 refined the same display paragraph so the SCD/SBD SQL is explicitly only an example for two available term types; that issue is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-35933 then removed the external code-system pages from FHIR core and redirected RxNorm guidance to HL7 Terminology; that issue is also already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/rxnorm.html is intentionally absent from the current core build, source/terminologies-systems.html links RxNorm to HL7 Terminology, and the current THO RxNorm page contains the corrected display section.
